messages:
tina: Hey benefits team — quick panicked question. Had to visit an urgent care in Puerto Vallarta last night while on a short trip. Clinic wants prepayment and a proof of coverage. I'm on Redwood PPO Gold. Does Acme cover emergency out-of-country care and what should I give the clinic?

sam_people_ops: Sorry to hear that. Short answer: emergencies abroad are typically covered as emergency/out-of-network services subject to plan cost share. Main ask: get an itemized bill/receipt, provider name, date of service, and any clinical note. Keep proof of payment if you pay up front.

tina: They gave me a receipt in Spanish, total $1,250 MXN? (or maybe USD — it's confusing) and a short note from the physician. Clinic says they can charge my card now.

olivia-benefits: If you pay, save the card slip and full itemized invoice. We can submit for reimbursement. Also get a simple English translation or at least a line-by-line photo. Broker can open an international claims case with Acme for expedited review.

broker-julia: Opening case ACME-INTL-202608-3347 and flagging for expedited reimbursement. Please DM the receipt, the physician note, and the last4 of your member card so I can attach to the case.

insurance-bot: ACME-INTL-202608-3347 created. Status: awaiting documentation.

tina: DM'd receipt + physician note + member last4 9901. Receipt is partly in Spanish, clinic phone included.

sam_people_ops: Also ask the clinic for a short medical statement (reason for visit) and the exact currency/amount. If you paid in cash, ask for a stamped receipt. If card, get the card authorization slip. These speed reimbursement.

broker-julia: Acme responded: they will process as emergency care. They asked for the original paid receipt and a 1-page medical necessity note translated to English. Est. turnaround: ~10 business days after docs. I've attached a request to ACME-INTL-202608-3347.

insurance-bot: ACME-INTL-202608-3347 updated: awaiting paid receipt and medical note.

tina: Clinic emailed a short translated note and I uploaded the paid card slip.

insurance-bot: ACME-INTL-202608-3347 closed: reimbursement approved at in-network equivalent; member reimbursed $980 after conversion and plan cost-share. Payment issued to card ending in 9901.

olivia-benefits: Filing internal tracker note: "International urgent care — broker escalated, docs submitted, reimbursement approved." Closing loop.

tina: Huge relief — thanks so much everyone! :sunglasses:
